observations: Photo 0: top of an inline engine with four black coil on plug ignition coils in a row on an aluminium valve cover, so four cylinders.
Photo 0: black oil filler cap printed SPEC ENGINE OIL with an oil can symbol, and a yellow dipstick handle; this cap style is common on Hyundai and Kia engines but carries no brand name.
Photo 0: raised lettering on the valve cover beside the coils is too blurred to read.

Photo 1: front of the same engine with alternator, belt tensioner, water pump and crank pulleys, black plastic intake manifold on the side, and a small stamped label on the timing cover that cannot be read.
Engine looks fairly clean and complete with sensors and hoses attached, sitting in a crowded spare parts shop.
No engine code, displacement, Hyundai or Kia badge, mileage or running clip is shown.
Both photos carry a Jiji dealer watermark (Emmy Gold Auto Spare).

identity.kind: used 4 cylinder petrol car engine, make and engine code not read
read_from: photo 0 oil cap reads SPEC ENGINE OIL only

claims.evidence: No Hyundai or Kia name or engine code is readable; the oil cap style in photo 0 is consistent but is not proof.
Photo 0 shows four coil on plug ignition coils in a row.

risks.risk: Engine code and displacement unknown; Hyundai and Kia 4 cylinder engines span small and large sizes with very different prices.
risks.proof: A sharp close photo of the engine code stamped on the block or the timing cover label and the valve cover lettering.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; the engine code sets the price

risks.risk: Engine may knock, burn oil or have low compression, a known issue on some Hyundai and Kia 4 cylinder engines.
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car, with sound, and a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Block or head may be cracked or the engine may come from a flood or crash car.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the underside including the sump and block.

risks.risk: ECU, wiring harness, gearbox or accessories may not be included.
risks.proof: A photo of every item included laid out, with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.

proof_requests: Sharp close photo of the engine code on the block and the label on the timing cover.
Clear photo of the valve cover lettering.
Clip of the engine running with sound.
Photos of all sides and the sump.
List and photo of what is included, with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
response.reason: It is a used 4 cylinder engine, but neither the make nor the engine code is readable, and that code is what sets the price, so not even a worst case can be priced until it is shown.
